mapper.insert: INSERT INTO org_department_leader (id, dept_id, user_id, leader_type, is_primary, sort_order, status, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{deptId}, #{userId}, #{leaderType}, #{isPrimary}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE org_department_leader SET dept_id = #{deptId}, user_id = #{userId}, leader_type = #{leaderType}, is_primary = #{isPrimary}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM org_department_leader WHERE dept_id = #{deptId} AND is_primary = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
